profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at PRA Group
profile.summary: Top Secret Clearance (2019 - 2024). In a field where technology feels boundless, I enjoy venturing into new facets in the digital space. My experiences as a full stack developer, designer and systems engineer combine to bring a unique perspective to address human problems through digital mediums.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: I specialize in designing user experiences that prioritize compassion and respect for individuals facing financial hardship. I led the development and design efforts for the PRA Pay web application, a key tool in debt recovery. This application aims to significantly reduce user stress by offering a more understandable and supportive experience, empowering individuals to take control of their financial situation. My key contributions included developing features for seamlessly setting up flexible payment plans and leading the implementation of a digital wallet, multi-factor authentication, ACH bank validation, A/B testing, and orchestrating product releases.
positions.insights: ASP.NET, Microsoft SQL Server and +3 skills

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Led the consultation and complete redesign of a local restaurant's website, significantly enhancing their branding and user experience. I collaborated closely with the client to weave their family story and cultural heritage into the design, modernizing the site with enhanced visual design, accessibility standards, and full mobile responsiveness to meet evolving customer needs during the pandemic. The end result was a website that faithfully reflected their narrative while effectively serving the community.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description: Our team supported the firm's Exchange environment for over 25,000 employees. My role provided critical support, ensuring the platform's stability, performance, and security with a Top Secret clearance. I collaborated with the Security and Law Department to develop a web app to capture external email threats for risk analysis and data spill prevention. Furthermore, I built automation scripts using PowerShell and the Microsoft Graph REST API to optimize the infrastructure, rapidly troubleshoot issues to minimize downtime, and facilitate the migration of on-premise users to the cloud.

positions.title: Systems Engineer Intern
positions.description: My focus was on streamlining operations and improving user experience. I assisted the Exchange team in the migration of user mailboxes from on-premise systems to the cloud. I also developed a web application that empowered employees to manage their email distribution lists, resulting in the cleanup of over 5,000 unused lists. Furthermore, I created process documentation that significantly increased the Support team's efficiency and productivity.

positions.title: Software Tester Intern
positions.description: I successfully transformed the manual testing process into an automated testing framework. This move immediately increased efficiency and saved considerable time, allowing us to streamline the testing cycle. The result delivered faster feedback to developers, accelerating the overall development process.

honors.title: Booz Allen Hamilton Passionate Service
honors.description:
For Travis's efforts automating several tasks
 
Travis Nguyen is being groomed as a junior PowerShell programmer on the Email Team. He collaborated with his peers on the Identity Management team on the distribution list (DL) cleanup effort, resulting in thousands of DLs being identified for deletion. Travis worked closely with a senior member of the team to automate the notification message to hundreds of employees regarding DLs that are no longer being used and tagged for deletion. He continues to follow through with the notification messages and makes ongoing tweaks as necessary. Travis also worked on the development of a script so that contractor mailboxes are migrated to the cloud (these mailboxes are initially created on premise due to the way the Messaging and Identity Management (MIM) system works). Travis has automated several other tasks, including mobile device wipes during emergency terminations, which reduces risk to the firm. He takes the initiative to be proactive in identifying areas for improvement without being asked, for example, creating a script to improve the patching process for the Exchange servers. Travis usually has the highest closure rate on the Email Team when it comes to Help Desk tickets, diligently chasing down issues to bring them to a successful conclusion, and receiving high praise for his client service. He is a subject matter expert (SME) when it comes to consolidating mailboxes for contractors who have transitioned to full time employees. Travis also volunteered for the Information Services roadshows, visiting several locations and following up with some of the client staff to resolve issues that they brought up during these events.

honors.title: Booz Allen Hamilton Passionate Service
honors.description: Mr. Travis Nguyen was brilliant in his help to me concerning a variety of computer issues and I could not be more grateful for his diligence, client service expertise, and meticulous attention to detail! Mr. Nguyen was professional, extremely knowledgeable, and not only solved my immediate computer problems, but helped me with longer-term client site connectivity issues. He took on my problem as though it was his own and spent close to an hour solving a myriad of issues, for which I am extremely grateful. As a result of his hard work, I am able to be much more efficient and effective in completing client deliverables because of the obstacles he has removed. Many thanks to Mr. Nguyen for being a truly exceptional employee!
honors.issuer: Issued by Booz Allen Hamilton · Jun 2019

projects.title: Expensify
projects.description: I developed a web application to manage expenses using React-Redux in ES6. Expenses can be filtered using the cost amounts and date of purchase, which I integrated using Airbnb datepicker library. The web app was deployed with Firebase, using asynchronous listeners and Google Authentication to hold expense information for multiple users. I conducted testing and enforced functionality by simulating user interaction using Jest and Enzyme.

projects.title: Rice Paper Website
projects.description: Through my love for design, I naturally taught myself HTML and CSS. This was a project for a local Vietnamese restaurant. I initially started with conducting research of demographics of the locals and their surrounding areas. As well as organizing user interviews from a wide-range audience to create my usability scenarios. After discussions with my client, I brought our vision to life by teaching myself Sketch to create the website's mobile and desktop wireframe. After multiple iterations, I made the site while providing consultation and support throughout the project's lifecycle. In the end, we successfully created a rebranded face for the restaurant to attract more customers.
